title: MgB2: two-gap superconductivity (anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg) and the sigma-band kink
summary: Electron-phonon system folder of MgB2: the coarse coupling from the ph.x dvscf files, interpolated in the PAO basis with pair-resolved Wigner-Seitz sums: alpha^2F, lambda and Tc, the Fermi-surface pair coupling, the isotropic and anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg gaps (the sigma and pi gaps), the ARPES kink of the sigma band and the phonon dispersion.

steps.label: Quantum ESPRESSO: scf, ph.x, nscf
steps.note: qe/phonon: scf and ph.x on the 3^3 q-grid (fildvscf); qe/nscf: the 6^3 nscf, started from a copy of the scf charge density (run_qe.sh does it); NP ranks, 8 by default

steps.label: Eliashberg function and Fermi-surface coupling
steps.note: 24^3 k = q with the Fermi-surface coupling (8 min on 20 ranks)

steps.label: ARPES kink of the sigma band
